scope.reason: Recompute canonical paragraph text and inline projections from captured source material, preserving numeric superscript indices with caret delimiters. Re-read portal statute links against their anchor text: links whose provisions the anchor does not print lose them, links naming another act or a bare paragraph become plain text, and the metadata lists what was dropped. Also revalidates publisher head-matter ordering across the complete document AST; A clerk's closing mark printed after the decision is read as a publisher note rather than head matter; paragraph roles have no feature storage of their own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Paragraph roles are recomputed from stored raw through the shared Polish role grammar on letter-spacing-collapsed text: a bench's names or a signing label with its blank under the ruling sign it, and a letter-spaced reasons heading opens the reasons; roles have no feature storage of their own. A ruling opens at its first point or its operative verb, read through letter spacing; a line that only looks marked or a list the recital announces stays in the recital, recomputed from stored raw; roles have no feature storage of their own. A document titled by its own declared type keeps that title and its reasons heading as a section, a ruling sentence that opens on its legal basis is the holding, a point whose number runs on to its verb opens the ruling, the bench opens on either wording of its composition line, and the holding ends where the bench signs; recomputed from stored raw, roles have no feature storage of their own. A printed table of contents is apparatus, a block of marks alone (a lone dash or dot) carries no body role, and in the competition authority's PDFs a short line set wholly in bold between paragraphs of the reasons is a subheading; recomputed from stored raw, roles and headings have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a docket line printed again inside the decision (Sygn. akt. I C 155/19, or set as a heading by the layout) is case-number, not a ruling point or a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: the instruction on the remedy against the decision (Na orzeczenie … przysługuje skarga, od niniejszej decyzji przysługuje odwołanie), where the remedy is filed, and every line under the instructions' heading (Pouczenie) carry no role; the heading is a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a head-matter line a layout sets as a heading (the decision's date, who sat on the bench) is intro, not a section heading. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Headings are recomputed from stored raw: in a competition authority's PDF a short line set wholly in bold heads its part of the reasons also when it is numbered in the outline (1. Status przedsiębiorcy) or numbers itself (Przykład nr 12), while a ruling point, a table row with amounts or currency and an abbreviation (a/a) stay paragraphs. Headings have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: an authority's decision titled by its docket alone (DECYZJA RGD - 1/2026) has that title instead of a supplied one, and a numbered ruling point under the authority's numbered title opens the holding. Roles and headings have no feature storage of their own. Roles are recomputed from stored raw: a paragraph that opens on the recital and rules in its last clause (po przeprowadzeniu postępowania …, uznaje się, że …) is the recital, then the ruling, and the ruling's legal basis read before it is intro; the printed text is unchanged. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Paragraph numbers are recomputed from stored raw: a number the court prints at the start of its reasons' paragraphs moves into the paragraph's number where the reasons read as one numbering, and the data-protection authority's paragraph unit placed straight in a chapter of its reasons gives its paragraph that unit's number; a numbered unit nested in another unit stays a list item. Paragraph numbers have no feature storage of their own.
